_comment: PROTOCOL EXAMPLE ONLY. These are fixed answers, not computed results, and
they are not a conformance reference. The subset exists so that one run of
`occurframe test` exercises every terminal shape an engine maintainer has
to implement: an `occurrences` answer that the scorer accepts, a
deliberate `rejection` of invalid input, and `unsupported` for everything
outside the table. Any vector absent here answers `unsupported`.
The `occurrences` values below are copied from the authored RC2
expectation for CRON-ANCH-001 under the `exclusive` start-inclusivity
policy that this example declares in its `hello`. That is what makes the
example score as conformant; it demonstrates the scoring path, and says
